scraped.scraped_description: We write guides for activists. Learn how to become a social activist, plan a political campaign strategy, and start a grassroots movement.

name: Activist Handbook
sdg_alignment: SDG 16 – Peace, Justice and Strong Institutions
dependency_risks: Relies on volunteer contributors; sustainability dependent on continued grant funding and community engagement
news_articles: Activist Handbook launches free resource for campaigners (2019)
How activists are building knowledge commons (2021)
academic_citations: Cited in research on digital activism and knowledge commons
governance_model: Community-driven with core team oversight; open contribution model
curation_criteria: Content reviewed by community members and core team; focus on practical, evidence-based activism strategies
political_relevance_summary: Addresses barriers to meaningful citizen participation in democratic decision-making by providing tools for public engagement and deliberation.

movement_building_utility.notes: Provides practical resources directly usable by organizers and campaigners.

generalizability_notes: Open-source codebase facilitates replication and adaptation. Already deployed across multiple jurisdictions (6 countries), demonstrating cross-context adaptability. Methodology and approach could inform similar efforts in other jurisdictions.
